full_judgment: 6. This is a suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession. Burden of proof heavily lies upon the plaintiff whether they acquired title in the property and from which portion of the plot they have been dispossessed or the defendant encroached. However, the plaintiff thought it better to get the suit property investigated upon by a survey knowing advocate commissioner on certain points, accordingly, the trial court allowed the application.
